blocks.goal: Reduce the size and complexity of AcceptReject by extracting the cohesive whole-string acceptance and rejection implementation while retaining the existing nested API for compatibility.

ops.details: Extract the fields and implementation associated with exact-string and wildcard acceptance, rejection, prefix tracking, and wildcardIndex into a top-level AcceptRejectWholeString class in the same package. Keep the existing nested AcceptReject.AcceptRejectWholeString as a compatibility adapter extending or delegating to the extracted class, and preserve its constructor and public methods.

blocks.goal: Reduce the number of implementation methods in AcceptReject by extracting the cohesive prefix-based matching implementation while preserving existing callers.

ops.details: Extract the prefix-based addToAccept, addToReject, isAcceptedAndNotRejected, isAccepted, acceptHasPrefix, and isRejected implementations into a top-level AcceptRejectPrefix class in the same package. Keep the existing nested AcceptReject.AcceptRejectPrefix as a compatibility adapter with the same constructor and public API.

blocks.goal: Remove leaf-name-specific behavior from the large target class by extracting it into a focused class.

ops.details: Extract the leaf-name-specific overrides of addToAccept, addToReject, isAcceptedAndNotRejected, isAccepted, acceptHasPrefix, and isRejected into a top-level AcceptRejectLeafname class in the same package, extending the extracted AcceptRejectWholeString implementation. Keep the existing nested AcceptReject.AcceptRejectLeafname as a compatibility adapter with the same constructor and public API.
